title: Microsoft Teams: pinch to zoom on shared screens
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, default state and sharing-policy guidance are supported. Cite the cmdlet reference and acknowledge that Microsoft's support article still says Mac trackpads do not support meeting zoom, despite Mac being listed on the roadmap.

claims.claim: Screen sharing mode is reached in Teams admin center through Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Content sharing > Screen sharing mode.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit. Go to the Content sharing section. These settings are described in the Screen sharing mode

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -ScreenSharingMode <value> updates a meeting policy's screen-sharing mode.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy
    [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>]
-ScreenSharingMode
Determines the mode in which a user can share a screen in calls or meetings.
claims.fix: Keep the command unchanged. Set controls[0].api.docs and its rendered Learn link to https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy?view=teams-ps and add that reference to sources: the cited overview names the cmdlet and ScreenSharingMode, while this reference documents the full command, including Identity.
